releaseNotes: My Player profiles: add your kids on the My Player tab; each gets a stats card (average, hits, walks, strikeouts) and tapping a card opens that player’s full stats. On the Team page, the My Player button is now a dropdown of your players: picking one links that roster player to the right kid and fills in the roster name. The Stats page player picker now lists your players. The top banner now shows the app name instead of a player name. No other gameplay changes.
